question:
Choose the correct active voice form of the sentence:

"The editorial is written by Mamatha."
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The subject of the passive voice sentence becomes the object of the active voice sentence.
 
• In the passive voice, the sentence is: "The editorial is written by Mamatha."
 
• To convert to active voice: Place the subject "Mamatha" at the beginning.
 
• Change the passive verb form "is written" to "writes" (present simple active).
 
• Ensure the sentence structure is correct and conveys the same meaning as the original.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Mamatha writes the editorial."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"Mamatha has writing the editorial." – Incorrect grammar (incorrect tense structure).
 
• **Option 3: **"Mamatha is writes the editorial." – Incorrect grammar (redundant auxiliary verb).
 
• **Option 4: **"Mamatha writing the editorial." – Incorrect grammar (missing auxiliary verb).
